title: Vocabulary Index v1
description: Unified cross-repo artifact index for all semantic vocabulary schemas. Used by consumers to discover available vocabularies, their paths, schemas, and health status.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this index was generated

description.description: Human-readable description of this index file

vocabularies.description: List of all vocabulary artifacts in the project

VocabularyEntry.description: A single vocabulary artifact entry in the index

id.description: Unique identifier for this vocabulary (e.g. zone-vocabulary, poi-vocabulary)

path.description: Relative path to the vocabulary artifact JSON file

schema.description: Schema identifier this vocabulary conforms to

schema_path.description: Relative path to the JSON Schema file for validation

phase.description: Discovery phase number that produced this vocabulary

row_count.description: Total number of rows/entries in the artifact

source_inventory.description: Source file used to generate this vocabulary (if applicable)

source_files.description: Source files used to generate this vocabulary (if multiple)

source_inventories.description: List of source inventories used to generate this vocabulary

total_inspected_payloads.description: Total number of payloads inspected during generation

CrossReference.description: A cross-reference between two vocabulary artifacts

IndexSummary.description: Aggregate summary of the entire index

total_vocabulary_schemas.description: Number of vocabulary artifacts in the index

total_schemas.description: Total number of schema files (vocabulary schemas + index schema)

total_artifact_rows.description: Sum of all row counts across all vocabulary artifacts

all_schemas_valid.description: Whether all referenced schemas are present and valid
